title: Outcome
description: What the pipeline concluded about one turn: the detail of an Outcome event (source factorial.outcome) on the factorial-work bus, also stored as outcome/outcome.json and recorded as `result` on the ledger row. Emitted only by the orchestrator, once per work item, at its terminal state; the reporter for its source type delivers it. Pointers only, never content. Internal to Factorial, not part of the WorkItem API.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

workItemId.description: The turn's WorkItem: one outcome per work item.

threadKey.description: The thread, <owner>/<name>#<branch>, once Intake has found it.

route.description: The route Intake chose (contracts/intake/v1). Absent when the turn ended before Intake chose one.

source.description: Copied from the WorkItem: where the request came from, and so which reporter delivers the outcome.

inReplyTo.description: Copied from the WorkItem when present: what the turn continues.

repository.description: Where the code lives, which is not always where the request came from.

result.description: What the turn concluded, from a fixed enum.

reason.description: For refused only: why Intake refused the turn.

artefactPrefix.description: The attempt's artefact prefix, <workItemId>/<attempt>/. Its report.json carries what delivery needs.

pullRequest.description: The pull request the turn opened or updated, or the one a rework turn continued.

testedSha.description: On pr-opened and pr-updated: the commit the checks passed on, which is the branch head.

savedWork.description: Untested work pushed to the branch although the turn did not finish: after a failed build.

commits.description: The work item's commits over every round, when known.
